mapper.sql: uc.id, uc.user_id, uc.item_id, uc.title, uc.patient_name, uc.age, uc.gender, uc.category_id, uc.remark, uc.content, uc.ai_summary, uc.is_public, uc.create_time, uc.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , c.name AS categoryName, u.real_name AS userRealName FROM user_case uc LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = uc.category_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_case (user_id, item_id, title, patient_name, age, gender, category_id, remark, content, ai_summary, is_public) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{title}, #{patientName}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{categoryId}, #{remark}, #{content}, #{aiSummary}, #{isPublic})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_case SET is_public = #{isPublic}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_case SET item_id = #{itemId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
